description: Generate a complete, editable presentation or document from a prompt (for a social post, story or ad use create_social_design instead: it starts from a designed template and places the member's own picture and logo). Waits for the result when generation is quick; otherwise returns a job to poll with get_job. The composed deck contains laid-out text, a theme, and speaker notes; per-slide images are generated in the creadal editor. Requires the 'generate' scope.

brandPalette.description: Brand hex colors to ground the theme in.

language.description: Write all text in this language, e.g. 'Spanish'.

motion.description: Entrance motion on the slides; defaults to subtle.

prompt.description: The brief, e.g. 'a 6-slide pitch deck for an eco water bottle'.

sources.description: Grounding material the outline is based on.

templateId.description: A template id from list_templates: the deck is composed on that template's layout system and theme.

themeId.description: A built-in theme id from list_themes (e.g. 'theme-slate'); omit for an auto-picked look.

name: generate_presentation
title: Generate a presentation
